What Our Team Loves About Rayzone Group

Ron Leib

Head of presales & Customer Success

I love working at Rayzone Group because it combines the agility and mindset of a startup with the scale of a mid-size company, which allows me to have real influence at a strategic level.

Working closely with Tier 1 customers is especially rewarding. I enjoy helping them solve real, day-to-day challenges and seeing the direct impact of our solutions on their operations.

Omer Tsafir

Product Manager & Automation Engineer

Coming from QA automation in cybersecurity startups, I found at Rayzone Group a culture that actively encourages learning, mentoring, and career evolution.

The company supported my product management studies, promoted me into my first PM role, and surrounds me with meaningful work, great people, and intimate yet over-the-top company events.

Stav Harpaz

Junior Full Stack Engineer

The work at Rayzone Group combines meaningful technical challenges with high standards, alongside a supportive and pleasant environment that encourages learning and growth.
For me, it reflects a company culture that supports both professional growth and a positive working environment.

Ariel Aviv

Project Manager, Delivery Department.

I love working at Rayzone Group because it genuinely feels like a family.

There’s a strong sense of trust, support, and belonging that makes even the toughest days meaningful.

The environment constantly challenges me with complex projects around the globe that push my limits, and overcoming those challenges brings deep satisfaction and pride.

It’s rewarding to be part of something that both supports me and inspires me to grow every day.

Shir Zada

Administration Coordinator

I joined Rayzone Group right after completing my military service with very limited experience, and over time I was given the opportunity to grow, learn, and become confident and independent in my role. The trust, flexibility, and support I received especially during my academic studies and reserve duty made me feel truly valued.

What stands out most is the people: a respectful, caring, and welcoming environment where learning is encouraged and every voice is heard. The open and approachable communication, including with management, creates a motivating and positive workplace that I am proud to be part of.

Aviv Ittah

Financial Controller

I enjoy working at Rayzone Group because it is more than just a workplace. It truly feels like a family. I’m surrounded by amazing people, a supportive culture, and an environment built on trust, collaboration, and positivity. The company encourages growth, gives real opportunities to take responsibility and develop, and constantly pushes you to become better, both professionally and personally.

Being part of Rayzone Group it is something I truly value.

Life at Rayzone Group: People First. Always.
